title: Pure Melodious
summary: Melodious cards only, with generic staples. The 2024 cards lead. Refrain the Melodious Songstress searches a Melodious monster when summoned. Couplet the Melodious Songstress summons a Level 4 or lower Melodious whenever it is added to the hand, and as a Scale it searches a Melodious Spell/Trap. Both return to the Pendulum Zone from the Extra Deck when a Melodious Fusion Monster is summoned. Ostinato Fusion Summons from the hand and Deck and brings the materials back in the End Phase. Melodious Concerto fuses from the hand, field and Pendulum Zones and draws when a Melodious Fusion hits the GY. Bacha the Melodious Maestra summons a Melodious from the Deck and stops your Melodious Fusions from being negated. Flowering Etoile the Melodious Magnificat bounces their cards on either turn.
